exposure: Presence of generalist surgical teams led by family physicians (MDGP)
Availability of surgical equipment and infrastructure
outcome: Performance of essential surgical procedures (e.g., Caesarean section, laparotomy)
Adequacy of enabling environment for surgery
cohort: 39 hospitals in 25 remote districts in Nepal
finding: The study found that despite low specialist surgical workforce density and often inadequate infrastructure, essential surgical care, primarily Caesarean sections, is being provided in remote districts of Nepal by generalist teams led by family physicians.
mod_finding: Generalist surgical teams led by family physicians were primarily performing Caesarean sections, the most common major operation in these settings.
